widgets_values:
A high-end luxury skincare product poster for FPSA brand, featuring three premium items — a ceramide repairing serum in a sleek glass dropper bottle with metallic cap, an eye cream jar labeled “RE-PLUMPING MOISTURIZING EYE CREAM,” and another serums bottle floating diagonally. The composition is minimalist yet dynamic: the products are arranged on a gradient gray-to-white reflective surface under dramatic studio lighting that casts sharp geometric shadows and highlights soft lens flares to enhance modern sophistication.

The central focus is the transparent 10ml ceramic-repairing serum bottle positioned slightly forward, its label clearly displaying "FPSA" logo (bold sans-serif font), followed by “CERAMIDE REPAIRING SERUM” beneath it using clean, tech-inspired monospaced typography; Chinese characters below read “神经酰胺 焕肤修护精华液.” All text uses subtle silver-gray gradients or embossed effects for depth without overpowering the visuals.

To the left rear sits the compact eye cream container – cylindrical white body with brushed metal lid – bearing “FPSA® RE-PLUMPING MOISTURIZING EYE CREAM” printed vertically along side edge in matching minimalistic typeface, accompanied by smaller Chinese script at base (“充盈弹力眼霜”). Above this, suspended mid-air like a floating element, is the second serum vial tilted backward—its label reads “CERAMIDE UPTAKE TECHNOLOGY” above the main title—and features mirrored chrome detailing echoing futuristic design cues.

Color palette strictly controlled: dominant cool tones of matte charcoal grays transitioning into luminous whites and silvers across background planes, contrasted subtly against translucent frosted-glass textures of bottles and lids. Accent colors include polished stainless steel sheen from caps and pump mechanisms, reinforcing precision engineering aesthetic while maintaining elegance.

Typography hierarchy:
– Primary Brand Name ‘FPSA’ appears large and bold centered atop each item’s packaging, rendered in ultra-modern condensed sans serif.
– Product names use thin-line uppercase letters aligned cleanly next to logos.
– Subtitles/functional descriptors employ italicized micro-fonts placed directly underneath key terms—for example，“MOISTURIZING EYE CREAM” runs horizontally just below primary name.
– Volume indicators ("NET VOL.28ML") appear small but legible near bottom edges via fine linear fonts integrated within structural lines of containers.

Composition layout follows diagonal rhythm principle: all objects lean toward lower-right quadrant creating visual momentum leading viewer's eyes through space—from top-left hovering bottle → center-forward serum → left-backward eye cream—with negative space intentionally preserved around them enhancing airiness and exclusivity.

Light direction originates from upper right corner casting long angular shadows extending downward, simulating natural sunbeam effect combined with artificial spotlight ambiance—a signature style seen in professional cosmetic advertising campaigns emphasizing purity, innovation, and scientific integrity.

Final output must be fully descriptive English prompt suitable for AI image generation tools:

---

**Prompt:**  
Ultra-high-resolution luxury beauty advertisement poster showcasing three FPSA skincare products: Ceramide Repairing Serum (glass ampoule with metallic dropper cap), Re-plumping Moisturizing Eye Cream (white jar with brushed aluminum lid), and another lightweight serum bottle floating elegantly overhead—all set upon a smooth gradient gray-to-silver reflective plane bathed in cinematic backlighting producing crisp shadow geometry. Background transitions softly between deep slate gray and bright clinical white with faint light streaks suggesting advanced lab illumination. Text elements feature minimalist sans-serif letterforms with embedded metallic glows and micro-gradient overlays; branding 'FPSA' displayed prominently as bold iconographic mark on every vessel. Typography includes functional labels such as “CERAMIDE REPAIRING SERUM”, “RE-PLUMPING MOISTURIZING EYE CREAM”, and volume specs (“NET VOL. 28 ML”) presented precisely adjacent to respective product forms. Color scheme dominated by sterile whites, mirror-finish chromes, and subdued graphite undertones accented only where needed with glossy liquid reflections mimicking skin hydration properties. Composition utilizes strong diagonal movement guiding gaze from airborne bottle down through foreground serum then back toward occluded jar, framed naturally within spacious negative margins conveying both technological precision and organic care philosophy. Style evokes contemporary medical-grade aesthetics fused with avant-garde editorial photography techniques ideal for global e-commerce platforms targeting discerning consumers seeking efficacy-driven formulations rooted in science-backed ingredients.

--- 

This optimized version ensures maximum clarity for designers translating concept to digital rendering while preserving emotional resonance tied to prestige, performance, and trustworthiness inherent in premium skincare marketing strategy.
ut_lens, 极简风格单片光学镜片悬浮展示，镜片完全无反光、无高光，呈现防反射镀膜质感。镜片的可见性来自光线折射、厚度变化、边缘透射与内部渐变，而非表面反射。镜片极薄，轮廓由一圈极淡的蓝色光学边缘线定义，整体高度通透、无畸变。背景为安静的浅蓝渐变，大量留白，柔和漫射光照，科学级、高端光学视觉语言，克制、纯净、精准。

ut_lens, ultra-minimal non-reflective optical lens floating in space, single transparent prescription lens with matte optical clarity, no specular highlights, no mirror reflections. Lens visibility defined by subtle refraction, edge transmission, and thickness gradient, faint blue optical edge glow. Smooth organic lens shape, ultra-thin glass, soft internal light falloff. Background is a calm sky-blue gradient with high negative space. Soft diffused lighting, anti-reflective coating effect, high-end scientific optical aesthetic, clean, precise, silent, minimal.

ut_lens,超干净的光学镜片悬浮展示，仅保留单片镜片主体，无镜架。镜片为矩形偏圆角造型，边角柔和，整体比例修长。超薄透明玻璃材质，镜片边缘经过精细抛光，轮廓处带有淡淡的蓝色高光描边。镜片表面呈现轻微防反射镀膜反光，在上缘可见浅粉色与淡紫色渐变光泽，具备真实光学清晰度与物理合理的镜片厚度。背景由多层半透明流动曲面构成，蓝色渐变的波浪状层叠结构，形似光学膜层或液态玻璃的抽象形态。整体画面留白充足，浅蓝到白色渐变背景，柔和影棚光照，高端光学产品渲染，未来感、极简、纯净。

ut_lens, 多层光学镜片悬浮于空间中，数片超薄透明镜片以平行且略微错位的方式排列，形成明显的纵深层次结构。每一片镜片为圆润不规则曲面形态，具有轻微弧度变化。镜片表面完全无反光、无高光，不呈现镜面效果。镜片通过**折射变化、厚度差异、边缘透射以及轻微光学渐变色（蓝紫调）**来体现存在感。边缘带有极淡的蓝色与紫色轮廓光。背景为深蓝渐变并带有柔和扩散光，营造空间深度。整体为未来感、高端光学视觉，极简但具有结构层次。
